_comment: Reconciled against the actual designed *_test.md files from workflow run #2 — see scripts/test_data.py's module docstring for how the fixture-instruction variables (patient_with_booked_appointments, patient_with_cancelable_appointment, self_booked_slot_time) work, and PRESEED_DOCTOR_ID/PRESEED_OTHER_PATIENT_SLOT there for the one variable that needs real server-side setup (other_patient_booked_slot_time).

doctor_short_bio.value: Primary care and annual wellness visits.

self_booked_slot_time.value: 2026-09-22 10:00 — before this step, first open http://localhost:5050/doctor/osei in this same browser session and book Dr. Nia Osei for appointment type 'New Patient' at exactly this slot (2026-09-22 10:00), so it is already booked by you when this step attempts to book it again

other_patient_booked_slot_time._note: Pre-booked server-side before the suite starts by scripts/test_data.py's preseed_other_patient_booking() — must match PRESEED_DOCTOR_ID/PRESEED_OTHER_PATIENT_SLOT there.

patient_session.value: not applicable — this site has no sign-in requirement, proceed directly without any authentication step

patient_with_no_appointments.value: a fresh browser session with no prior bookings — no setup needed, proceed directly

patient_with_booked_appointments.value: a fresh browser session where you first book exactly two appointments before proceeding to Step 1: (1) open http://localhost:5050/doctor/kim and book Dr. Grace Kim for appointment type 'New Patient' at slot 2026-09-21 08:00; (2) open http://localhost:5050/doctor/holt and book Dr. Derek Holt for appointment type 'Follow-up' at slot 2026-09-21 16:00. Complete both bookings first, in this same session, then continue to Step 1.

patient_with_cancelable_appointment.value: a fresh browser session where you first book exactly one appointment before proceeding to Step 1: open http://localhost:5050/doctor/chen and book Dr. Liam Chen for appointment type 'New Patient' at slot 2026-09-21 13:00. Complete that booking first, in this same session, then continue to Step 1; this is the appointment that is safe to cancel.
